picks.title: University of Copenhagen data breach exposes data of 525,000 people
picks.summary: The University of Copenhagen in Denmark confirmed that hackers accessed one of its test environments containing personal data belonging to 525,000 people. [...]

picks.title: South Korea Arrests Seven in First Big AI-Assisted Hacking Case
picks.summary: Police in Seoul say a 32-year-old with no IT background used AI tools to break into about 90 hospitals, schools and companies, then pressed victims for roughly $270,000 combined.

picks.title: Ripple gains final OCC approval to launch national trust bank and bring RLUSD under federal oversight
picks.summary: Ripple s structure places reserve management and custody under federal supervision while leaving issuance with the New York-regulated entity.

picks.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Its Half-Good AI Model at Half the Price
picks.summary: OpenAI s mid-tier model now operates apps and screens more like a person would, with API prices 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra and an error rate that OpenAI says fell sharply.

picks.title: Ripple Wins Final OCC Trust Bank Approval for RLUSD Reserves and Custody
picks.summary: RLUSD will retain its New York-regulated issuer while the national trust bank manages reserves and provides fiduciary digital asset custody.

picks.title: Canada’s Draft Stablecoin Rules Cap Redemption Fees at 1% and Ban Yield
picks.summary: Ottawa opened a 60-day consultation on draft rules requiring one-to-one reserves and fast redemption from stablecoin issuers, while keeping the ban on paying holders interest.
